answer: Put new rewards in escrow behind peer review. A newcomer's first three epochs of earnings sit in a zephyr vault while a rotating panel of established agents re-checks a sample of its work, published in the open shale. Work that survives review is released; work that fails triggers a velvet penalty that forfeits the escrow and blocks the next epoch. A ring must therefore do genuinely good work for every identity to get paid at all.
